purpose: Phase-7C tumour immune-visibility structure. Defines the separable stages of immune recognition (antigen availability -> detectability -> presentation potential -> effective recognition) and their bounded contributors. Tumour-cell death is NOT equated with perfect visibility, and not all apoptosis is assumed strongly immunogenic. Section 1 establishes this contract; the calculation is implemented in a later section (outputs UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no antigen count or immunogenicity constant (NOT_REPORTED).

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic visibility the model represents
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: stages are separable; antigen presentation efficiency is NOT folded into visibility (it is computed separately) to avoid double counting.

double_counting_rules.no_presentation_in_visibility: effective_recognition consumes antigen-presentation effectiveness once, from the antigen-presentation domain; visibility does not independently recompute it.
